_help: AI providers the note writer shares work between. A provider is used only if its key (env) is set as a GitHub secret. rpm/rpd = requests per minute/day this pipeline allows itself (kept under each free tier). If a model name stops working, change it here. models: tried in order when one is retired or too big for the free limits; "auto-free" picks OpenRouter's current free models. "auto" for Gemini = every Flash model the key can use (each has its own daily allowance); a model that runs out for the day is swapped for the next. parallel: notes asked for at once per provider (still within rpm).
